description: One fighting-game move in the shared frame-data language (FIGHTING-SYSTEMS.md). All durations are integer frames at 60 fps. Fields marked x-bannon-extension are the wrestling extensions; everything else is the Capcom-published conventional vocabulary.

boxes.description: Box states over the move's timeline. Coordinates are in the home repo's box unit, origin at the character's floor anchor, x forward. Art never overrides boxes (FIGHTING-SYSTEMS.md §2).

fromFrame.description: First frame (0-based, from move start) this box state applies; applies until the next entry.

cancels.description: Which phases may be interrupted into which follow-ups. The combo system is data (TEARDOWN-fighting-sega-capcom.md §2).

onHit.description: Move ids cancellable into, on hit.

conditions.description: x-bannon-extension: sim-state predicates required for the move to be legal (FIGHTING-SYSTEMS.md §3).

grapple.description: x-bannon-extension: present when the move is a throw/grapple (FIGHTING-SYSTEMS.md §3).

endsWithPin.description: On completion, control passes to the pinfall ruleset named in pinfallRulesetId.

escapeWindow.description: Frames at clinch start during which the defender's throw-break input escapes.

pinfallRulesetId.description: Names a pinfall ruleset owned by the home repo (canon slot — values are not defined in this package).

id.description: Stable move id, snake_case. Never renumbered once shipped (replays and frame tables cite it).

bufferWindow.description: Frames before legality during which the input is stored. House default 6.

motionWindow.description: For motion inputs: frames after motion completion during which the final input still counts. House default 12.

notation.description: Human-readable input, e.g. '236+P' or 'close: LP+LK'. The notation legend lives in FIGHTING-SYSTEMS.md §4's home-repo conventions.

name.description: Display name (Mochiichao/BANNON naming law applies: display names are canon, ids are plumbing).

hitstop.description: Frames both characters freeze on contact.

launch.description: On hit, the defender leaves the ground.

onBlock.description: Frame advantage for the attacker when the move is blocked.

onHit.description: Frame advantage for the attacker when the move hits (positive: attacker acts first).

pushback.description: Horizontal push applied to the defender on contact, in box units.

active.description: Frames during which the move can hit.

recovery.description: Frames after active during which the character cannot act (unless cancelled).

startup.description: Frames before the move can first hit.

meta.description: Provenance/status annotation, ignored by the sim. Example and template files must carry meta.status saying so.

title: frame-data
